spanish: Ofrenda de principio las acercarán a Jehová, y al altar ellas no subirán a olor de reposo.
grammarChanges: Inserted the explicit subject pronoun 'ellas' before 'no subirán'. Spanish -án is identical for formal 'ustedes' (hiphil 2mp 'acercarán') and 'ellos/ellas' (qal 3mp 'subirán'), so without a marked subject the clause reads as if the addressees are the ones not ascending. 'Ellas' points back to the offerings, matching the qal 3mp subject in the source; participants and who-acts-on-whom are unchanged.
readerNote: Added 'ellas' only to mark the subject of 'no subirán' as the offerings, not the addressees of 'acercarán'; both verbs share the Spanish -án ending.
